scope: Minimum privilege and progressive scope governance for auth, tools, resources, connectors and runtime operations.
implementation_evidence: src/auth/oauth21_authorization_server.js accepts only mcp:tools for the active OAuth21 internal profile and rejects unsupported or inflated scope sets at authorization and access-token validation
src/runtime/decision_runtime_context_builder.js carries the authenticated scope set into the tool decision context
src/runtime/decision_runtime_policy.js requires mcp:tools for every tools/call executed under the active oauth21/internal profile and fails closed with insufficient_scope before tool execution
SERVER_AUTH_SPEC.json provides the scope-to-profile boundary and src/tool_policy.js provides the profile-to-tool boundary; the runtime decision now binds them through the granted scope set
_tests/smoke_oauth21_scope_validation.js and _tests/smoke_decision_runtime_p1_coverage.js guard issuance-time and tool-dispatch scope enforcement
mcp:operator remains unissued by the active OAuth21 server, so scope elevation is inactive and cannot bypass explicit future consent design

sessionless_ready_review.notes: Root spec reviewed for sessionless-ready workflow posture; stable connector route remains unchanged and sessionless activation/migration remain separate explicit operator stages. The hidden /mcp/sessionless route is a historical transition route, not the final target architecture, and it is now retired from active repo runtime and confirmed absent on live OAuth21 3008 after the controlled restart.
